meta.note: 55 raw findings across four passes deduplicate to 40 tracked items. Status is the point of this file: a finding with no status is a finding nobody closes.

status_vocabulary.FIXED: addressed in the design and committed
status_vocabulary.DROPPED-BY-SCOPE: cannot occur in phase 1 (open + upcoming IPOs only); reopens for phase 2
status_vocabulary.BUILD-GATE: not a design fix - a condition the build must satisfy before it ships

findings.title: The freeze has no release condition, and contradicts document healing
findings.detail: A DRHP issue size frozen in July is never corrected by the September RHP. Confirmed by 2 reviewers.

findings.title: The freeze starves the only signal that could unfreeze a wrong value
findings.detail: data_conflicts rows need a second source to arrive; the freeze means rounds 2 and 3 are never asked, so §3's trigger can never fire on frozen fields.

findings.title: E-1 points six fields at sources that do not carry them; §2.8 then deletes the data
findings.detail: filing-persister.ts:867-869 is the only writer of the three ipo_details dates; no exchange scraper writes them. Would blank 13 correct values on live pages.
findings.closed_in: PROVEN by live fetch 2026-09-08: NSE /api/ipo-current-issue and BSE IPO_HomePageDetail carry open/close/status (and NSE listing date) but NO allotment, refund, credit or anchor-bid date, and no scraper maps one. S-05 now splits: the 5 the exchange publishes move to it; the 5 nobody publishes stay document-sourced with a staleness trigger keyed to a visible window change. 13 live values preserved.

findings.title: §2.8's null-write is impossible through the writer the design keeps, and fails silently
findings.detail: data-consolidation-service.ts:1063-1080 returns the stored value on a null incoming and logs nothing.

findings.title: Round-1 yield rises when extraction gets worse
findings.detail: The denominator is produced by the machinery under test. A mis-resolved document type shrinks it and the score goes up.

findings.title: Four checks are vacuous when their input collapses to zero
findings.detail: 4.2, 4.3, 4.8, 4.13 all read healthy at 0/0. Needs a denominator floor on every ratio.

findings.title: Nothing proves the re-read actually opened a file
findings.detail: A purged PDF plus a 404 lets an implementation confirm a wrong value forever and then defend it against the website that was right.

findings.title: Five checks are written to a log with no consumer that diffs it
findings.detail: Violates signal-ownership R3, which the design quotes approvingly two pages earlier.

findings.title: Backlog re-download is undone by decidePurge on the next cycle
findings.detail: document-store.ts:279 hard_cap is unconditional past 30 days. Reopens for phase 2.

findings.title: Checks wrong for a class silently blank that class
findings.detail: NCD face value 1000, pre-Dec-2023 T+6 listings, pre-2025 SME lot rule. All 19 phase-1 IPOs are current-era plain IPOs. Reopens for phase 2.

findings.title: Appendix A resolves only 3 of 11 offering types
findings.detail: Phase 1 contains only IPO mainboard, SME-BSE and SME-NSE - exactly the 3 resolved. Reopens for phase 2.

findings.title: 162 of 194 fields have no consolidated writer at all
findings.detail: consolidatedUpsertIPO covers the ipos table only; eight child tables have their own writers. The largest single piece of build work, hidden in a bullet saying nothing changes.

findings.title: The mapping is scoped to fields populated today, so document-only facts can never enter
findings.detail: About 46 document-printed columns are empty and therefore absent from the plan. Confirmed by 2 reviewers.

findings.title: The walk is killed at the 30-minute cron boundary as the scheduled steady state
findings.detail: Single pm2 instance, --cron-restart */30, worst-case pass 30 min, spawnSync blocks the SIGINT handler so the lock is held for its full 45-min TTL. Needs a per-row commit boundary and a resume point.

findings.title: No lock, no stated granularity, for the walk
No crash recovery; a silent LOCK_NOT_ACQUIRED marks a plan row SUPPLIED for a write that never landed
NOT_PRINTED vs NOT_AVAILABLE_YET is undecidable from a per-type manifest
findings.detail: The two have opposite permanent consequences and §2.5 gives the same example for both. Derive from lifecycle stage.

findings.title: The NOT_AVAILABLE_YET reclaim has no bound and no backoff
WITHDRAWN and POSTPONED IPOs match no tier and are never walked
findings.detail: Confirmed by 3 reviewers. A phase-1 IPO can become either at any time.

findings.title: Nothing rebuilds the plan when offering_type, segment or listing_exchanges is corrected
findings.detail: Measured: no committed type change in 327 IPOs, but Mopshop was stored FPO, disagreed 24 times, and was corrected by hand.

findings.title: An ADMIN override is a one-way door; clearing it never returns the field to the loop
Anchor lock-in dates are computed from the bid date; the rule is 30/90 days from allotment
findings.detail: anchor-investors-scraper.ts:302. An existing production bug of roughly a week. UNVERIFIED against the circular.
findings.fix_in: Appendix A + a separate bug fix

findings.title: Pre-IPO placement and green-shoe change the issue size after the RHP; the design stores a boolean
NCD structure cannot be represented (base vs retained size, series, coupon, tenor, rating)
InvIT/REIT: §1.11 says out of scope, A.2 assigns them 117 resolvable fields
Fixed price is treated as an SME property; it is a property of issue_type
findings.detail: A fixed-price issue has no bid book and a different allocation split. Phase 1 has SME IPOs which are commonly fixed price.

findings.title: The basis-of-allotment extractor is scheduled with nowhere to write
A check that crashes reads as an improvement in floor-delta
findings.detail: It parses FAIL/PASS only; a vanished check appears as GONE and prints 'no new findings'.

findings.title: Check 4.8's healthy value contradicts §3.4's own bounds and would be permanently red
Four of the six migration gates are prose, not commands
field_sources holds one prior value, so the per-field rollback claim fails past one overwrite
Check 4.6 asserts on declared ranks, not on field_sources.source - it reads intent, not outcome
The public API ships 19 fields that are null on all 327 IPOs, with no retirement plan
No check has an id, an emitting script, a host or an owner
findings.detail: So §3.5's tier-differentiated issue routing cannot be built on the existing per-check-id path.

findings.title: A nightly backlog drain adds a third extractor to a 2-vCPU box that already took a 522 outage from two
findings.detail: scripts/deploy-linux.sh:231-235 records the incident. No backlog drain in phase 1.

findings.title: §1 and Appendix A contradict each other; the document says so instead of fixing it
findings.detail: Being closed by generating §1 from the same spec as Appendix A.

findings.title: E-1 stated as both nine and twelve fields
The plan-completeness check had three different expected values (131/150/153)
findings.detail: Replaced with an assertion against a committed manifest sha - comparing the generator's output to a number the generator produced detects nothing.

findings.title: The mapping is designed, not observed; no stage verifies a named source actually serves the field
findings.status_note: BUILD-GATE: becomes the first step of the build.

findings.title: Three of the 19 phase-1 IPOs have segment = NULL, so no rank set can be resolved for them
findings.detail: Found 2026-09-08. BSE-only UPCOMING rows. SME and mainboard have different lot-value checks.
findings.closed_in: design rule written 2026-09-08: infer segment from lot x cap >= Rs 50,000 on a single exchange. Measured: mainboard median 14,880 vs SME 127,600; the three unknowns 109,200-144,000, all BSE-only, all SME. The prod data repair remains an owner call.

findings.title: GMP is gated to market hours with subscription, so it is stale exactly when people read it
findings.detail: index.ts:343 runs live:GMP only inside isMarketHoursIST. Measured 2026-09-08 22:03 IST: weekend GMP fetches 2045 before the scheduler, 0 after; newest gmp_records row 16:02 while it was 22:03. timestamp is our own fetch clock (investorgain-gmp-orchestrator-v2.ts:536). Up to ~65h stale over a weekend. Proposed: split the live step - subscription and demand graph stay gated, GMP runs every wake while UPCOMING or OPEN.
findings.closed_in: owner approved 2026-09-08: split the live step, GMP runs every wake while UPCOMING or OPEN

findings.title: Discovery has a 15-hour overnight hole (17:30 to 08:30)
findings.detail: Hypothesis, not measured - our own data cannot show it because discovery only runs at the four slots. If price band ads are commonly filed in the evening, the site shows no band the night before an issue opens. A fifth ~21:00 slot would close it. Owner decision: domain knowledge our data cannot supply.
findings.closed_in: owner approved 2026-09-08: add an evening discovery slot

findings.title: E-1 contradicts the approved source-tier spec S-03/S-04 on the timeline
findings.detail: per-ipo-due-step-pipeline.md §6 (2026-09-03) says tier-1a filings are truth for every static field INCLUDING the timeline, and a tier-1b exchange value must never override a filing. E-1 puts NSE/BSE above the document for the 12 timetable fields. Both have reasons; they cannot both stand. Design position: E-1 wins for those 12 only. Owner must confirm - it changes an approved spec.
findings.closed_in: owner confirmed the re-filing test 2026-09-08; recorded as S-05 in per-ipo-due-step-pipeline.md §6, E-1 reframed as its application rather than an exception

findings.title: A rank-2/3 fetch by constructed slug can silently return a DIFFERENT company page
findings.detail: OBSERVED 2026-09-08: requesting chittorgarh.com/ipo/prasol-chemicals-ipo/1234/ returned HTTP 200 with the Empyrean Cashews IPO page - a real page for a different company. The CG scraper carries a companyName identity anchor only inside the issue-size PROSE fallback (chittorgarh-detail-fields.ts:551), not as a gate on the fetch itself. A pull loop fetching rank 2/3 by constructed URL would write one company figures onto another. Fix: every rank-2/3 fetch must assert the returned page names THIS IPO before any value is read, and record the assertion in the plan row.
findings.fix_in: §2.4 — a precondition on every non-document fetch

findings.title: Two ranks were asserted rather than observed; a live fetch disproved both
findings.detail: promoters.name was marked document-only - a live CG page prints "Company Promoters: <names>", so CG is now rank 2. peer_companies.pbv_ratio was given CG at rank 2 - the same page carries NAV, EPS, P/E and market cap but NO P/BV, so it is now document-only. Both corrected from evidence, not assumption. This is the first real-fetch verification of any rank (partial close of F-39).
